children: Ampco-Pittsburgh posted an investor presentation outlining business strategy, 2025 results and targets for margin, growth and debt reduction.
Published investor presentation on Sept 23, 2026 to be used with existing and prospective investors.
Presented 2025 results: $434M revenue, $29.2M adjusted EBITDA (6.7% margin) and ~$385M backlog.
Strategic plan targets $7–8M annual EBITDA uplift from portfolio actions and a path to 10%+ adjusted EBITDA margin.
Air & Liquid Processing aims for ~10–12% organic revenue growth; Buffalo Pumps approved ~$9M Navy funding for capacity expansion.
Net debt/EBITDA trend ~3.0x; forecasted EBITDA growth and free cash flow expected to reduce leverage over time.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
